name: alert
title: Alert
summary: A message in the page: a note, a success, a warning or an error.
description: A message that sits in the page: a note, a success, a warning, an error. A tone icon, a title, a description and optional actions, on the card's box (radius.card, 12px padding). The tones are status-pill's four status tones and their tint pairs: neutral is the card itself (surface on shadow.card); accent, green, orange and red fill with their tint, the icon takes the tone's colour and the text stays ink, so it reads at any length. Static: no engine, no motion.

anatomy.description: role="alert" for orange and red (announced when it appears), role="status" otherwise; the role prop overrides it. A row: the icon, then the content. Radius.card, padding 12px, gap 10px.

16px Phosphor glyph (bold) in the tone's colour (ink-3 when neutral), centred on the title's first line; aria-hidden. Default per tone: info (neutral, accent), check-circle (green), warning (orange), warning-circle (red). The icon prop replaces it; icon={false} removes it.
Takes the free space; holds the title, the description and the actions. min-width 0, so long text wraps inside it.
text.sm, weight 500, ink, line-height 20px. Wraps (never cut); author text keeps its own direction.
The default slot: text.sm, ink-2, line-height 20px, 2px under the title. Wraps anywhere (an unbreakable address never overflows).
Buttons (sm) in a wrapping row under the text, inside the content column so they line up with the title; 10px above them.

tone.description: status-pill's status tones. neutral: the card (surface, shadow.card), ink-3 icon. accent / green / orange / red: the tone's tint fill (accent-tint, green-tint, orange-tint, red-tint) and the tone's colour on the icon; text stays ink and ink-2.

title.description: The headline. An alert may have only a title, only a description, or both.

icon.description: Show the tone's icon. Your own glyph: a node (React), the icon slot (Vue), a snippet (Svelte).

role.description: Default: alert for orange and red, status for the others. none for an alert that is part of the page from the start and must not be announced.

actions.description: Buttons under the text (sm; outline unless given). Your own controls instead: the action prop (React, a node; Svelte, a snippet) or the action slot (Vue).

slots.actions: Your own controls in place of `actions` (React: the action prop, a node; Vue: the action slot; Svelte: the action snippet)

events.action: (value: string) when an action is pressed

notes: role="alert" (orange, red) is announced at once when the alert appears; role="status" politely. An alert rendered with the page is read in place; pass role="none" if it must not be announced at all.
The icon is decorative (aria-hidden): the title says what happened. Colour is never the only signal: the title and the icon carry it too.
Not focusable itself; its actions are ordinary Buttons in the tab order.

motion: none: an alert is part of the page; a component that shows or hides one decides how
